about: Draft judged query set for CollegeDash universal search (issue #507), the equivalent of ECNLDash #149 phase 1 PR 1 (#156). Judgements are facts from the published data and proposed owner decisions (C01-C19), never engine output. Draft: not yet frozen, not yet in the repo.

context.todayRun: today.mjs ran the page's own matcher (public/index.html inline script) in a vm on 2026-10-21 machine time: the ID Camps list held 80 camps, not the 81 of 2026-10-20 (hope-college's 2026-10-20 camp had passed). A frozen clock is required before any camp count is pinned.

stability.frozen: registry facts: names, searchNames, nicknames, division, conference, city/state, colours. Change only by a reviewed registry edit. May carry top (exact first).
stability.slow: College Scorecard and NOAA figures (asOf 2026-09): enrollment, tuition, admission, climate. Judged on a frozen fixture; counts quoted are as of dataAsOf.

refKinds.list: filter state, in the page vocabulary where it exists (division, region, conf, cond as COND_FIELDS, sort: public/index.html:1261, :3581); state, city, color, snow, religiousAffiliation are new facets
refKinds.empty: an empty or help state with a reason
refKinds.notice: a word the box could not apply, named back to the reader (never silently dropped)

decisions.C01: Section order follows the strongest reading of the query (as ECNL D1/D2); default programs, lists, conferences, camps, people.
decisions.C02: "small" = under 5,000 undergraduates (recs size band lt5k, public/recs.js:46; fit constants.sizeBands[0]).
decisions.C03: "under 30k" = the page's Tuition condition (out-of-state, else in-state; public/index.html:1268): 79 small D3 programs. Alternatives: cost of attendance (36) or net price (305).
decisions.C04: "warm" = fall average high above 80F (the Ask eval's climate-warm, tests/fixtures/ask/eval.json:983).
decisions.C05: Conference abbreviations and brand names (B1G, Big 10, CCAA, NESCAC, UAA, GLIAC, Pac 12) come from a cited alias table built by the refresh, like registry searchAliases; a conference means its current members only.
decisions.C06: "blue" = a school colour (first or second) whose hue is blue, derived from the hex in programs/index.json by the refresh. A program with blue only as its second colour (syracuse) is allowed, never required.
decisions.C07: Words every program shares ("soccer", "women's", "college" when typed with a name) and "the" never empty a result; "st" and "saint" are the same word (as the camps search, public/index.html:4385).
decisions.C08: One name shared by several programs: all show; proposed D1 before D2 before D3 within equal matches.
decisions.C09: A word that is both a conference and a program name (MAC, American, Metro, New England): both rows show; the owner picks which section leads.
decisions.C10: "New England" = the data's Northeast region (CT, MA, ME, NH, RI, VT; public/data/fit/index.json constants.regions).
decisions.C11: A two-letter capitals code is a state (#404, public/index.html:1077); the owner decides whether LA also (or instead) means Los Angeles, as ECNL decided (D3), and whether an exact program alias (NE) leads.
decisions.C12: Cities: programs named after the city, then programs in it; whether nearby cities (Cambridge for Boston, Evanston for Chicago) show, labelled nearby, is the owner's call (ECNL D2 used the county).
decisions.C13: People: a current roster or enrolled record leads; a different person with the same name is a separate row; an earlier verbal or an earlier school is labelled, never hidden, never first.
decisions.C14: "near <city>" = programs within a radius of the city by school lat/lon; the radius is the owner's (the judged refs hold for any radius from 60 to 300 miles).
decisions.C15: Dates are read against a frozen clock and zone: "december" = the next December (2026-12), "this weekend" = the coming Saturday and Sunday.
decisions.C16: "snow" = fit climate cold (coldest-month mean below 27F) or a NOAA annual snowfall figure; a program with neither is unknown and never listed as snowy or snow-free. The snowfall cut-off is the owner's.
decisions.C17: A word with no data behind it (majors: "psychology") is named back ("not in CollegeDash's data") and the rest is labelled partial, never silently dropped (ECNL not-ignored, D4).
decisions.C18: Religious affiliation needs a code-to-name table (the data holds Scorecard codes only; none is in the repo).
decisions.C19: Very broad queries (university, college, a single letter) show a capped first slate fast; the draw cost is the phone budget, not the search.

queries.intent: owner's real query: division, colour, climate, major
queries.why: D1, blue and snow are hard filters the data can answer (colours are hex in programs/index.json; snow from NOAA annualSnowIn, 464 programs, and fit climate "cold", coldest-month mean below 27F). Majors offered are not in the data: only players' own majors on rosters (4,144 of 26,715 current roster rows list one; 280 mention psychology, at 111 programs): "psychology" must be named as not applied, never silently dropped. Clear members: buffalo (#005BBB, 95.4 in), canisius (navy, 95.4 in), notre-dame (navy, 64.5 in), marquette (navy, 48.7 in).
queries.elsewhere: None: no colour filter, no snow filter (only "Fall average high"), no majors. Ask (owner only) would mark it unsupported.

Each program file has school.religiousAffiliation as a Scorecard code (code 30 is held by notre-dame, georgetown, villanova, santa-clara, boston-college, xavier). The repo has no code-to-name table: not found, so the vocabulary must be added. byu (94) and baylor (54) are other affiliations.
The page's RPI condition (rank 25 or better), sorted by RPI, as the Ask eval expects (rank-rpi-top-25). Membership moves weekly, so only the filter state is judged.
